title: Your Process Development Lab Called. It Needs More Tentacles
summary: Streamline your bioprocessing with Culture Biosciences' innovative solutions, including Stratyx™ bioreactors and cloud-connected services. Explore more now.
body_markdown:
Bioprocess development can feel like you need eight arms just to keep up, which makes the octopus in this video strangely relatable.


Meet[Nexxys™](https://www.culturebiosciences.com/resources/bioprocess-development-anytime-anywhere-inside-cultures-nexxys-platform) from


Culture Biosciences


, a bioprocess development service designed to act as an extension of your own lab. From running experiments and managing bioreactors to delivering connected data and analysis, the Nexxys team helps your team scale process development without adding more chaos to your lab bench.


Watch the video to see how our Nexxys team helps you move faster, expand capacity, and spend less time untangling spreadsheets.
